parts.text: Some decimals have non-repeating decimal parts followed by repeating decimal parts. Example . . 0 65 0 65555 … = In this decimal, the 6 does not repeat but the 5 does.

parts.text: (a) Show that adding the decimal forms of 5 1 and 1 3 gives a decimal of this type.

content.tex: Show that adding the decimal forms of \(\frac{1}{5}\) and \(\frac{1}{3}\) gives a decimal of this type.
